title: Java Script Continue
text:
JavaScript Continue



The Continue Statement

The
continue
statement
skips the current iteration
in a loop.

The remaining code in the iteration is skipped and processing moves to the next iteration.
.

JavaScript Labels

A label provides a name for a statement, or a block of statements,
allowing statements to be referenced to, for program flow control,
particularly in loops.

Syntax

A label is an identifier followed by a colon (
:
).

labelname
:
statement
;

A label precedes a statement or a block of code.

labelname
: {

statements

}

Labelname

continue
labelname

and
